messages.content: Hi, this is Marcus Oyelaran. I’d like to request a refill on my lisinopril, please.
Can you please provide your date of birth to verify your identity?
My name is Marcus Oyelaran, and my date of birth is November 2, 1965.
I've escalated your request to a staff member since there are no refills remaining for your lisinopril. They will assist you shortly. Goodbye!
[direction] Say that is everything and thank them. End the call politely.

response.text: That is everything, thank you for your help. Goodbye!
